newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHF - No merger talks with Bankgesellschaft.
newsitem.headline: BHF - No merger talks with Bankgesellschaft.

text.p: The head of Germany's BHF-Bank on Thursday dismissed speculation that the bank might be taken over by Bankgesellschaft Berlin.
"Nobody has spoken to us about it," BHF management board chairman Ernst Michel Kruse told reporters in Berlin.
In any case, Bankgesellschaft, as a "state controlled bank ... would not be the ideal combination," with BHF, he said.
Kruse also said that Allianz AG Holding did not want to sell its 15.2 percent stake in BHF.
"There are currently no talks with any large banks," Kruse said, although he did not rule out a future co-operation with another institution, particularly in the domestic corporate client segment.
The German media has been speculating that Bankgesellschaft wanted to take over BHF Bank in recent weeks but Bankgesellschaft itself has said it was not presently in takeover talks.
